cues.creator: Kenney

cues.processing: Kenney Interface Sounds question_004.ogg, deliberately the same synth family and the same envelope as scan_hit but a lower, plainer tone (dominant partial 492 Hz against 2637 Hz) so a miss reads as duller than a hit. Decoded from Ogg Vorbis, converted to 44.1 kHz 16-bit stereo. No silence needed trimming. DC offset removed, 2 ms fade-in and 25 ms fade-out, peak normalised to -3.0 dBFS. No EQ, no pitch change, no time change.

cues.creator: Kenney
cues.attribution: Interface Sounds by Kenney (www.kenney.nl), CC0. Credit is not mandatory; the pack asks for it as a courtesy.
cues.processing: Kenney Interface Sounds confirmation_004.ogg, a rising two-tone confirm that reads as an instrument acknowledging a record rather than a plain beep. Decoded from Ogg Vorbis, converted to 44.1 kHz 16-bit stereo. No silence needed trimming. DC offset removed, 2 ms fade-in and 25 ms fade-out, peak normalised to -3.0 dBFS. No EQ, no pitch change, no time change.

cues.creator: OwlishMedia
cues.attribution: Sound Effects Pack by OwlishMedia on OpenGameArt, CC0. CC0 requires no credit; this line is a courtesy.
cues.processing: OwlishMedia Sound Effects Pack UI/UI_020.wav, a multi-event harmonic readout rather than a single blip, which suits a panel opening its analysis data. Converted to 44.1 kHz 16-bit stereo. 0.058 s of silence trimmed from the head and 0.204 s from the tail, then capped at 1.45 s to stay inside the 0.3-1.5 s brief, which cuts a fading final tail. DC offset removed, 2 ms fade-in and 60 ms fade-out over the cut, peak normalised to -3.0 dBFS. No EQ, no pitch change.

cues.creator: Kenney
cues.attribution: Interface Sounds by Kenney (www.kenney.nl), CC0. Credit is not mandatory; the pack asks for it as a courtesy.
cues.processing: Kenney Interface Sounds minimize_008.ogg, a short two-event tone centred around 355 Hz with no energy in the 1-4 kHz presence band, so it is heard without being sharp. Decoded from Ogg Vorbis, converted to 44.1 kHz 16-bit stereo. 0.011 s of silence trimmed from the head, nothing from the tail. DC offset removed, 2 ms fade-in and 25 ms fade-out, peak normalised to -3.0 dBFS. No EQ, no pitch change, no time change.
